clients_name_by_kind.name: clients_name_by_kind
clients_name_by_kind.value:
("clients"."kind" = 'person' and coalesce(trim("clients"."first_name"), '') <> '' and coalesce(trim("clients"."last_name"), '') <> '')
          or ("clients"."kind" = 'company' and coalesce(trim("clients"."company_name"), '') <> '')

contract_parties_share.name: contract_parties_share
contract_parties_share.value: ("contract_parties"."role" = 'owner' and "contract_parties"."share_pct" > 0 and "contract_parties"."share_pct" <= 100) or ("contract_parties"."role" <> 'owner' and "contract_parties"."share_pct" is null)

contracts_update_config.name: contracts_update_config
contracts_update_config.value:
("contracts"."update_mode" = 'none' and "contracts"."index_series_id" is null and "contracts"."fixed_update_pct" is null)
          or ("contracts"."update_mode" = 'index' and "contracts"."index_series_id" is not null and "contracts"."update_frequency_months" > 0)
          or ("contracts"."update_mode" = 'fixed_pct' and "contracts"."fixed_update_pct" is not null and "contracts"."update_frequency_months" > 0)
